bundle.shortDescription: Goal-driven orchestration runtime for coding agents
bundle.longDescription: Atlas Flow turns a Project Atlas Goal into planned, isolated, verified work: it decomposes a Goal into tasks, runs each in its own git worktree through a coding agent, and records the evidence every gate requires.
